title: Enterprise Request Distillation & First-Pass Envelope for Sales/CS
creator: Maya Thompson
description: Create a lightweight 'distillation' process and a first-pass scoping envelope that Sales/CS can use to consolidate enterprise non-bug feature requests into a one-page scoping summary. The goal is to reduce back-and-forth, surface key constraints (security/compliance, data residency, performance), and produce a consistent artifact for PM/Eng prioritization. Deliverables: a one-page Distillation Template, three filled examples (single-account, cross-account bundle, urgent security-led ask), a short async training doc, and a Slack workflow for submission.
acceptance_criteria:
- Sales/CS can produce a 1-page scoping envelope in under 30 minutes using the template
- Template captures: problem statement, top 3 outcomes, success metrics, required platforms/integrations, security/compliance constraints, rough scale estimate, potential fallbacks
- PM can prioritize the envelope against existing roadmap in a 10–15 minute intake
- Two Sales reps pilot the process with real accounts and file feedback in the linked Drive doc
- Template stored in Drive and linked to Linear + Slack workflow created
out_of_scope:
- Deep technical designs or final architecture docs
- Detailed engineering estimates beyond rough sizing (T-shirt: S/M/L/XL)
- Contract or legal changes (refer to Legal team for contract language)
proposed_flow: 1) Sales/CS aggregates raw asks and completes the Distillation Template; 2) Submission triggers Slack + Linear intake to PM queue; 3) PM performs a 10–15m quick-scan and labels as Quick-OK / Needs Research / Rejected; 4) Needs Research creates a spike (ENG) with a short acceptance criteria list; 5) If Quick-OK, PM assigns priority and adds to roadmap candidate list; 6) For bundles, include aggregation rationale and representative customer list; 7) Escalation: if customer impact is 'high' and legal/compliance is required, tag Legal and Security and route to the Enterprise Ops channel.
sample_email_snippet: Hi PM team, attached is a distilled scoping envelope for ACME Corp request. Problem: ACME requires private VPC deployment + SSO and customizable rollout policy per route. Outcomes: 1) Private deployment in US-East, 2) SSO via Okta, 3) Configurable rollout policy. Success metrics: reduce manual onboarding time by 50% and achieve <100ms median latency for targeting flows. Attached: Distillation Template (filled). Please advise next steps and estimated T-shirt sizing.
